book_name: 平鼻华象白蚁 Sinonasutitermes planinastus
en: The small soldier matches the large form in colour. Its head is round and slightly longer than wide, and the stout conical nasus, shorter than the head, projects straight forward so that its tip lies clearly below the vertex; the nasal base is slightly arched and the nasus-head angle is about 105 degrees. Antennae have twelve segments, the second shortest and the third longer than the second.
soldier: 小型兵蚁体色与大型相同。头圆而稍长，长过于宽；鼻作粗圆锥状，短于头长，侧面观平伸向前，端部明显低于头顶，鼻基稍拱起，鼻与头的夹角约一百零五度。触角十二节，第二节最短，第三节长于第二节，第三、四节近于相等。前胸背板前后缘均近平直。
